mentions.name: Plug-That-In
mentions.description: A paid Mac utility app that nudges laptop users to plug in before the battery dies, using floating, cursor-following notifications that are hard to miss regardless of what is on screen. Features include a Reminder Mode that emits a configurable, car-seatbelt-warning-style alert at critical battery levels until the battery is addressed, and Do Not Disturb settings to customize alerts and sounds based on context such as system audio playing, an active video, or the camera being in use.
mentions.problem: MacBook users deeply immersed in focused work, meetings, or video content miss low-battery notifications, leading to sudden shutdowns and the frustrating, sometimes embarrassing scramble to find a charger or power outlet.

mentions.name: Plug-That-In
mentions.description: A paid Mac app that reminds laptop users to charge their device with floating notifications that follow the cursor, so the nudge is noticed even during deep focus work, meetings, or engaging video content. Includes a Reminder Mode that beeps like a car seat belt alert at critical battery levels and Do-Not-Disturb settings that configure alert/sound behavior while system audio, video, or the camera is active.
mentions.problem: People deeply involved in focus work, meetings, or video content miss the standard low battery notifications, so their laptop shuts down suddenly, forcing an annoying walk to find a charger and embarrassing interruptions.
mentions.audience: An individual developer wanting a stronger nudge to plug in their MacBook during focus sessions, meetings, or video watching.
